fields.name: face_units
docs: Face value of one bond in cash-token base units.

fields.name: redemption_price_bps
docs: Redemption price in basis points of face (10_000 = par).

fields.name: issue_day
docs: Day serials (days since 1970-01-01).

fields.name: payment_days
docs: Business-day-adjusted payment day of each coupon period (computed off-chain with the bond's calendar).

fields.name: record_days
docs: Record day of each coupon period; the record moment is `record_seconds_local` on that day.

fields.name: payment_seconds_local
docs: Payment opens at this local time on the payment day (never before the record moment).

fields.name: chain_origin
docs: Time model: bond time = bond_origin + (chain time - chain_origin) * 86_400 / chain_seconds_per_bond_day.

fields.name: supply
docs: Bond supply over record moments. Only the program changes supply (placement, redemption), and it saves
the history first, so the supply at any record moment is known without counting holders.

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Issue size in bonds, fixed by the terms: placement never takes the supply above it.

fields.name: payment_days
docs: Business-day-adjusted payment day per period, from the bond's calendar (off-chain).

fields.name: record_days
docs: Record day per period (equal to the payment day in markets that fix holders on payment day).

fields.name: weekend_days
docs: Non-business weekdays as a bit mask: bit 0 = Monday ... bit 6 = Sunday.

fields.name: bond_origin
docs: Bond time that corresponds to the chain time of this instruction.

fields.name: chain_seconds_per_bond_day
docs: 86_400 = real time; smaller compresses the bond's life (devnet demo).

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Issue size in bonds: the most the registrar may ever place.

types.name: BondsBoughtBack
docs: Bonds bought back and burned, price paid (FirstCome sale or ProRata settlement).

types.name: CouponBasis
docs: How a coupon is computed (see `bond_math::amount::AccrualBasis`).

types.name: Event
docs: One coupon or the redemption. Created once its record moment has passed, so its inputs are final.
Read-only on the payment path.

fields.name: record_time
docs: Record moment and payment opening, in bond time.

fields.name: supply_at_record
docs: Bond supply at the record moment (from the bond's supply history).

fields.name: budget
docs: Cash that covers every holder of this event: the amount for the whole supply, rounded down once. Each
holder's amount is rounded down on its own, so the holders' amounts never add up to more than this.

fields.name: vault
docs: This event's own cash account; other events cannot spend it.

types.name: HolderRecord
docs: One registered holder of one bond: its quantity over record moments and the coupons already paid.

fields.name: escrow_of
docs: A trade escrow's record (`admit_trade`): the seller whose bonds it holds. Bonds in a DvP escrow stay in the
seller's position (locked) until the trade settles, so a record moment inside an open trade still pays the
seller. Zero for a holder's own record. Third field, so the transfer hook's extra-account list can read it
at a one-byte offset (`HolderRecord::ESCROW_OF_OFFSET`).

fields.name: paid
docs: Bit `e` set = coupon `e` paid.

fields.name: locked
docs: Bonds committed to offers: tendered into open offers, or accepted by a closed offer and not yet bought. They
stay in the holder's account (and keep their coupon rights), but the transfer hook refuses transfers that
would take the balance below this, and redemption leaves them to their offer.

fields.name: redeemed
docs: Bonds redeemed at maturity so far. Principal for each partial redemption is the difference of the principal
on the cumulative quantity, so several partial redemptions round exactly like one.

fields.name: escrowed
docs: Bonds the holder has put into open DvP trade escrows (`admit_trade`). They are part of the holder's position
(quantity = token balance + escrowed) until a trade settles; like locked bonds they cannot be transferred,
tendered or redeemed meanwhile.

types.name: Offer
docs: An issuer's offer to buy back bonds at a price per bond, up to a maximum quantity, during a window.

fields.name: price_units
docs: All-in cash price per bond, in cash-token base units.

fields.name: open_time
docs: Window in bond time: open <= t < close.

fields.name: total
docs: Bonds bought (FirstCome) or currently tendered (ProRata).

fields.name: vault
docs: The offer's own cash account.

fields.name: tenders
docs: Tenders made (ProRata): each new tender takes the next number.

fields.name: resolved
docs: Tenders resolved so far, in the order they were made.

fields.name: resolved_quantity
docs: Bonds tendered by the tenders resolved so far.

types.name: PositionHistory
docs: A quantity over the bond's record moments. Record moments are numbered 0..periods in time order.
`quantity` is the quantity now. It has not changed since the last change, which happened when `live_from`
record moments had passed. So the quantity at record moment `e` is:
- `at[e]` if `e < live_from` (saved by the first change after moment `e`);
- `quantity` otherwise (no change since moment `e`).
`save` must run before every change; then no record moment's quantity is ever lost or overwritten, however
late anyone looks.

types.name: PositionsSaved
docs: A holder's quantity was kept for record moments [from_event, to_event) before it changed.

types.name: Tender
docs: One holder's tender into one pro-rata offer.

fields.name: number
docs: Its number in the offer: tenders are resolved in this order.

fields.name: resolved
docs: After the window: the accepted part is fixed and the rejected part released (no cash involved).

fields.name: settled
docs: The accepted part has been bought (burned and paid).

types.name: TenderResolved
docs: After the window: a holder's tender split into accepted (still committed) and rejected (released) bonds.

types.name: TradeAdmitted
docs: A Solana DvP trade admitted: its escrow may hold `quantity` of the seller's bonds, which stay the seller's position
(locked) until the trade settles to the buyer or unwinds.

types.name: TradeMoved
docs: Bonds moved through a trade escrow: into it (locked for the seller), to the buyer (settled) or back to the seller.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: Cash account of one event: ["vault", event].
